title: Thigh Liposuction Malaysia | Inner & Outer Thigh Fat Removal – Dr. Soma
description: Thigh Liposuction in Malaysia by Certified Plastic Surgeon. Slimmer legs and smoother shape using MicroAire PAL. Inner and Outer thigh fat removal.

acceptedAnswer.text: A surgical fat-removal procedure that contours the inner and/or outer thighs by removing excess subcutaneous fat to improve leg shape and proportion.
Small incisions are made, a fine cannula is used to suction fat after tumescent infiltration, and MicroAire Power-Assisted technology helps support smoother, more uniform contouring.

mainEntity.name: When will I see results after thigh liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: You'll start noticing changes at 4–6 weeks, with final contour visible between 3–6 months as swelling fully resolves.

mainEntity.name: How long does thigh liposuction last?

acceptedAnswer.text: Results are long-lasting because fat cells removed do not regenerate. Maintaining stable weight helps preserve thigh contour.

mainEntity.name: Does thigh liposuction help with inner thigh rubbing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. By reducing inner thigh bulk, many patients experience less friction and improved walking comfort.

mainEntity.name: Does thigh liposuction tighten loose skin?

acceptedAnswer.text: It can provide mild tightening if your skin elasticity is good. If loose hanging skin is significant, a thigh lift may be recommended.
Pain is usually mild to moderate and often described as soreness. Medication keeps discomfort manageable.

mainEntity.name: How long is downtime after thigh liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients return to desk work within 5–7 days. Exercise is typically resumed around 4–6 weeks with surgeon approval.
Incisions are tiny (3–4mm) and placed discreetly. Scars fade significantly over time.
When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a proper medical facility, thigh liposuction is generally safe. Risks exist like any surgery and are discussed during consultation.
